module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;
wire request_valid = |request;
wire masked_request_valid = |masked_request;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_prefix;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_prefix;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_winner;

genvar g;
generate
    for (g = 0; g < PORTS; g = g + 1) begin : priority_bits
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            if (g == 0) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_prefix[g] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_prefix[g] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : interior_bit
                assign request_prefix[g] = |request[g-1:0];
                assign masked_request_prefix[g] = |masked_request[g-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : msb
            if (g == PORTS-1) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_prefix[g] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_prefix[g] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : interior_bit
                assign request_prefix[g] = |request[PORTS-1:g+1];
                assign masked_request_prefix[g] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:g+1];
            end
        end
        assign request_winner[g] = request[g] & ~request_prefix[g];
        assign masked_request_winner[g] = masked_request[g] & ~masked_request_prefix[g];
    end
endgenerate

reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;
integer k;
always @* begin
    request_index = 0;
    masked_request_index = 0;
    for (k = 0; k < PORTS; k = k + 1) begin
        request_index = request_index | (k & {$clog2(PORTS){request_winner[k]}});
        masked_request_index = masked_request_index | (k & {$clog2(PORTS){masked_request_winner[k]}});
    end
end

wire hold_grant =
    (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (|(grant_reg & request))) ||
    (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid_reg && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge)));

wire use_masked = ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && masked_request_valid;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_winner = ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN ?
    (masked_request_winner | (request_winner & {PORTS{!masked_request_valid}})) :
    request_winner;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] selected_index = use_masked ? masked_request_index : request_index;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_prefix = use_masked ? masked_request_prefix : request_prefix;

always @* begin
    grant_next = selected_winner;
    grant_valid_next = request_valid;
    grant_encoded_next = selected_index;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && request_valid)
        mask_next = selected_prefix;

    if (hold_grant) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        mask_next = mask_reg;
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
        grant_reg <= grant_next;
        grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
        grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
        mask_reg <= mask_next;
    end
end
endmodule

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;
wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid[LEVELS-1:0];
wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc[LEVELS-1:0];
genvar l, n;
generate
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate
assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference routes priority selection through encoded indices, one-hot decoding, and variable-shift mask generation. The round-robin feedback path can therefore traverse multiple dependent selection and decoding stages before reaching mask_reg or grant_reg.",
  "rewrite": "Compute parallel priority-prefix reductions for raw and masked requests. Form one-hot winners directly, encode those winners only for grant_encoded, and generate the next round-robin mask directly from the corresponding request prefixes. Keep the original grant_reg, grant_valid_reg, grant_encoded_reg, and mask_reg names and encodings. Preserve blocking as a final hold selection and retain synchronous reset.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement comes primarily from removing index arithmetic and variable shifts from the mask feedback path, and removing encoded-to-one-hot decoding from the grant path. A numerical WNS improvement is not verified here; mapped STA under the specified constraints is required.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "No additional registers or pipeline stages. Prefix reductions and direct winner encoding replace the two priority-encoder/decode paths and mask shifters. Shared reductions should limit area, but mapping, buffering, electrical compliance, and the 4855.656960um2 cap remain to be measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For a nonempty request vector, each prefix bit indicates whether the winning request lies strictly on its higher-priority side; this is exactly the reference's shifted round-robin mask. Empty request cycles clear grant outputs while retaining mask_reg. Blocking retains all four state registers, including when requests change. Reset synchronously clears all state on every asserted sample. No initialization, startup assumptions, new latency, or input restrictions are introduced. The supplied standalone priority_encoder preserves its original invalid-input behavior. Internal arbiter index temporaries are zero when their request vector is empty; registered and external behavior remains unchanged."
}
